4. [RLOW.14.4] **Incremental compilation is an optimisation.** A compiler
   may recompile only the rules that changed, provided the artefact it writes
   is the one a full compile of the same source writes, so it carries the same
   `dsc_sha256` ([RDSC.3.6]). A runtime never compiles: it loads the artefact
   it is given.
